g.text: Change in E rate = E rate with mistranslation − E rate on clean passages

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: Positive values = more E responses than on clean passages; negative values = fewer E responses.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: This measures responsiveness, not the correctness of E choices. Llama 3.2 3B is excluded because no mistranslation runs are available.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: A mistranslated passage may still supply an answer. Higher E response rates do not by themselves establish better error detection.
